{{recipe}}

'''Thai pineapple curry''' (แกงสับปะรด / ''kaeng sap pa rod'') is a traditional curry of Southern Thailand. The recipe has crushed pineapple with juice, so it tastes both sweet and sour. It is often served over rice and [[Cookbook:Garnish|garnished]] with peeled orange slices, diced green onion, or celery.

== Ingredients ==
*175 [[Cookbook:Gram|grams]] [[Cookbook:Pineapple|pineapple]] pieces 
*2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] Thai [[Cookbook:Thai Red Curry Paste|red curry paste]]
*½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Coconut Milk|coconut milk]]
*8 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] [[Cookbook:Shrimp|shrimp]], or whatever meat desired 
*½ tablespoons [[Cookbook:Palm Sugar|palm sugar]]
*½ tablespoons [[Cookbook:Fish Sauce|fish sauce]]
*1½ tablespoons ripe [[Cookbook:Tamarind|tamarind]]

== Procedure ==
#[[Cookbook:Simmer|Simmer]] the coconut milk in a [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]] over medium heat for 5 minutes and add red curry paste.
#Put the sliced pineapple in the curry and wait until it is soft.
#Bring to a boil over high heat, then add the shrimp.
#Flavor the curry by adding the palm sugar, fish sauce, and ripe tamarind. Add more palm sugar for a sweeter curry, add more fish sauce for a salty curry, and add more ripe tamarind for a sour flavor.

== References ==
# http://www.yummly.com/recipe/Thai-Pineapple-Chicken-Curry-407083?columns=4&position=24%2F33. ''Thai Pineapple Chicken Curry''. Allrecipes UK.
# http://rasamalaysia.com/thai-shrimp-and-pineapple-curry. ''Thai Shrimps and Pineapple Curry''. Rasa Malaysia.
# http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gZrJ23pnaYs. ''How to cook Thai pineapple curry (Easy and tasty)''. Chantamas Srichong.
# http://www.pim.in.th/side-dish-by-squid-crab/763-pineapple-mussel-curry. ''แกงคั่วสัปปะรดกับหอยแมงภู่แห้ง''. พิม.
# http://foodthaicooking.blogspot.com/2013/08/blog-post_10.html. ''วิธีทำแกงกะทิสับปะรด''. เมนูก้นครัว.
